The camp
A genuine bush experience close to the convenience of Maun and the stunning beauty of the Okavango Delta.
After a 25-minute drive from Maun, the legendary safari city of Botswana, you will arrive at Tshima Bush Camp, set in 30 hectares of mature natural bush with direct access to the Nhabe River. Our Meru Style tents offer comfort and a lot of privacy. You can find porcupines, aardvark and a wide variety of birds. From time to time elephants also pass by and hippos inhabit the river.
The camp is an ideal base for exploring nearby natural resources such as the world famous Okavango Delta, Moremi Game Reserve Makgadikgadi Pans and Nxai Pan National Park. Tshima Bush Camp is an excellent stopover on the way from Namibia to the Delta. The camp is an ideal end of a Botswana trip on the way back to Namibia. Here in a cozy atmosphere, you can reflect upon impressions gained in recent weeks.
We are looking forward to welcoming you as our guests!
Classic, Meru-style luxury tents
Accommodation
Book Now
Classic, Meru-style luxury tents
Our Meru-style tents are luxurious and come with a private bathroom with a toilet and hot shower. The tents are located in the bush amidst the original vegetation. A private area around each tent allows you to enjoy nature and relax. The tents are positioned away from each other for total privacy. The morning choir of Frankoline and guinea fowl is your natural wake-up call!
A delicious, picnic style breakfast is always included in our rates. Breakfast will be served in the privacy of your own tent and a 3-course dinner (after a drink or 2 at the fire place) is served at the main house. Bush babies jump around and are frequently seen during dinner.
Activities
We can arrange a variety of (day) tours to the Okavango Delta, Moremi Game Reserve Nxai Pan National Park and Makgadikgadi-Pans. All excursions include transport and lunch.
“The Moremi, Makgadikgadi-Pans and Nxai Pan excursions also include game drives, while the trip to the Okavango Delta includes a so-called Mokoro Trip (a traditional canoe advanced by a poler through the canals of the Delta) and a walking safari.”
ONE LIFE, LIVE IT
Environmentally friendly
Tshima Bush Camp is fully self-supporting and ecologically responsible. We use solar energy exclusively and we win, recycle and purify our own water. Furthermore, our waste management and sewage systems contribute to our green profile.Solar geysers are used for hot water supply, also helping to reduce our environmental impact.
Your theme is beautiful, elegant and your support is first class! I ve gone from being a total novice to having a gorgeous site!”
NARELLE HANRATTY, THEMEFOREST.NET
